heading: What you can expect from us.
intro: Every trip starts from your own ideas, and your advisor shapes it around your needs and your budget.

services.title: Every step of the way
points: Tailor a holiday to your precise requirements
Care and guidance pre, post and during holiday

promises.title: Advisors who travel
promises.body: All of our advisors have travelled extensively and are delighted to share this first-hand knowledge and experience with you. We undertake constant training and travel regularly so that you can be assured of up-to-date knowledge of your travel destination.
paragraphs: It's hard to overstate the benefit of talking to an expert when it comes to planning your holiday. All of our advisors have travelled extensively and are delighted to share that first-hand knowledge with you. They take an unbiased, informed approach to planning holidays. We pool our resources so that each client benefits from our collective knowledge. Every itinerary is designed around your individual needs and budget. We undertake constant training and travel regularly so that you can be assured of up-to-date knowledge of your travel destination.

promises.title: Getting to know you
promises.body: Before we suggest anything, we ask what you enjoy, what you would rather skip and how quickly you like to move. The ideas we bring you come from that conversation, and we build the plan with you.
paragraphs: We like to treat our clients as we like to be treated ourselves. Our advisors pride themselves on their level of personal service and will do more than just organise your holiday logistics. Instead they'll take time to get to know you as a traveller. That way they can make informed suggestions as you work together to plan a holiday you'll love.

promises.title: A price for your dates
promises.body: We do not quote low-season “from” prices for dates you may never travel. We price your own itinerary for the dates you have in mind, so the price we give you is accurate from the start.
paragraphs: We believe that it's unfair to just show you 'from' prices that relate to the low season, when you may not want to travel. That's why we take the time to assess your personal itinerary for the dates you want to travel so that we can give you an accurate price for your holiday.

promises.title: Financial security
promises.body: Travelling Places holds a licence from the Australian Travel Industry Association, and our financial records are scrutinised as a condition of membership. We are an affiliate TIDS member of IATA, and client funds are held in a separate trust account.
paragraphs: Travelling Places holds an Australian Travel Industry Association Licence (ATIA), issued by the industry body.
We are an affiliate TIDS member of the International Air Transport Association (IATA).
To be a member of ATIA our financial records are scrutinised.
We operate a separate client trust account to ensure security of your funds.
